note: Validation questions with expected context, written BEFORE the rework and never used to tune it. A question passes when all `required` rules are in the first `window` rules returned and no `forbidden` rule is. Self-check, not a live or independent evaluation.

questions.text: Who has to say yes when someone wants a three week holiday?
Does a contractor need anyone's confirmation before getting into our systems?
A contractor asks for administrator access to the production systems. Who is involved?
An employee takes 35 days of leave and then wants to work remotely 4 days a week. Which approvals are needed?
Who approves travel spending over 250,000 yen?
From how many days of leave does the department head have to approve?
What is the policy on pets in the office?
Who approves a company car purchase?
